no trumpet on that date. I don't know why. I knew that there was supposed -- It doesn't mention here that there are strings. There's no tenor on there, either, is there? Yeah. Okay, we've also found another anomaly that's in the Bruynynckx discography. There's a tenor sax listed as being present -- Foots Thomas. And he's not there, and nor indeed is he listed in the Jepsen discography.
